proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: I dropped the car off at seven thirty and Renee texted at ten with a photo of the front pads and the rotor. She said the rear brakes had a while left and to leave them. Picked it up by four.
reviews.name: Tasha W.

reviews.text: Another shop wanted to replace three sensors for the check engine light. These guys found a cracked vacuum hose, charged me for the hose and the diagnosis, and the light has stayed off.
reviews.name: Omar K.

reviews.text: The clunk after the March potholes was a sway bar link, one side only. They showed me the play in it on the lift and didn't touch the struts.
reviews.name: Becky L.

reviews.text: Bought my daughter's first car from a guy in Mason. They put it on the lift the day before and found a brake line rusted nearly through. We talked the price down by the cost of the repair.
reviews.name: Jerome P.

reviews.text: My battery died twice in a week. They tested it, then found the trunk light staying on. New bulb switch, kept the battery. I appreciated being told the cheap answer first.
reviews.name: Hailey S.

reviews.text: The temperature gauge kept climbing on my commute. They pressure-tested the system, found the water pump weeping, and called with the price before ordering it. Ready the next afternoon.
reviews.name: Doug F.

reviews.text: My exhaust sounded like a tractor. They welded in a new section instead of selling me the whole system, and sent a photo of the rotted pipe they cut out.
reviews.name: Ana R.

proof.guarantee: Nothing is repaired until we call you with a photo, a price and your yes.
